fields.description: BRD C.10.5 asks for 4 client-specific display labels (e.g. Pacific's own "PDC"/"Against Order" wording) over this app's real, unchanged 5-state internal lifecycle (dms_erp.catalog.utils.DISCONTINUATION_STATUSES) -- remapping the states themselves needs Pacific's sign-off and is out of scope (see withdrawal_api.py's module docstring). This app is white-labeled: a different client's own preferred wording for each status is config, not code -- hardcoding "PDC" (short for "Pacific-discontinued") into shared code would bake this one client's name into every deployment. A status left blank or with no row here displays as its own raw internal value -- see catalog.utils.status_label.
fields.label: Discontinuation Status Labels
